paraphrase: Danyuan gave Yangshan the 97 circle-figures handed down from the six patriarchs through National Teacher Huizhong; Yangshan read them and burned them — 'having seen them once I know their meaning; one must be able to use them, not cling to the text' — and redrew them from memory when asked.
